purpose: Score the quality of currently EDGE_ACTIVE candidates using only verified Stage 5 research evidence, Stage 6 live regime quality, Stage 7 activation-match quality, and Stage 8 portfolio ranking. This score is a prioritization-quality measure, not a current-session probability, trade signal, or trade authorization.

inputs.stage6_regimes: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.stage7_activation: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output
inputs.stage8_ranking: Stage 8 PSY29 Portfolio Edge Ranking output

research_strength_score.meaning: Verified historical behavioural evidence strength; not a current-session probability.

live_regime_quality.meaning: Quality assigned to the current directional regime by the locked Stage 8 contract.

activation_match_quality.meaning: Strength of the explicit research-to-live-condition match that activated the edge.

portfolio_rank_quality.meaning: Relative prioritization quality inherited from Stage 8; not an independent market signal.

final_score.interpretation: Candidate quality/confidence index only. It must never be described as a probability of profit, probability of continuation, or expected return.

fail_closed_rules: Exactly 29 canonical symbols must be present.
Stage 5 research profiles must cover exactly the canonical 29.
Stage 6, Stage 7, and Stage 8 inputs must each cover exactly the canonical 29.
Only EDGE_ACTIVE rows may receive a quality/confidence score.
EDGE_INACTIVE, DATA_STALE, and DATA_INVALID rows retain their state and receive null score and null rank.
EDGE_ACTIVE requires fresh Stage 6 data and a valid Stage 8 ranking score/rank.
No score may be emitted when required provenance or component inputs are missing or inconsistent.
Historical research evidence remains a behavioural prior and is not converted into a current-session probability.
Trade authorization and trade signal generation remain hard-disabled.

provenance.stage6_source: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2
